caption: Lost your job? Epictetus was born a slave, won his freedom, then lost his city to an emperor's decree. His first lesson: separate what's in your power from what isn't. Full breakdown on our page. #stoicism #epictetus #layoffs #resilience #mindset

Where does your $5 latte go? Starbucks's own fiscal 2025 numbers: $2.29 runs the store, $1.57 buys the coffee, milk and cup, and about 25 cents is profit. Data: Starbucks FY2025 results (SEC filing); company-wide shares applied to a $5 example. #starbucks #coffee #latte #personalfinance #dollartrail

Sunday night, and Monday is already in your head. Seneca's fix: walk through the week's problems on paper before they show up, and end with a plan instead of a loop. Save this for next Sunday. Source: Seneca, Moral Letters to Lucilius, Letter 91, tr. Richard M. Gummere. #stoicism #seneca #sundayscaries #mindset #stoic

A $12.09 AMC ticket, followed: $5.81 of it went to the studios. The theater makes its money at the snack bar, and in 2025 it barely broke even. Data: AMC Entertainment full-year 2025 results (SEC Form 8-K, Feb. 2026); per-visit figures = 2025 totals divided by 219.4 million admissions. #movies #amc #popcorn #personalfinance #dollartrail

Marcus Aurelius started his mornings by expecting to meet difficult people. Before you check your phone, name the one you'll probably run into today. When it happens, you saw it coming. Source: Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 2.1, tr. George Long. #stoicism #marcusaurelius #difficultpeople #morningroutine #stoic

Your $144 electric bill, followed: 56% pays to make the power and 44% pays to get it to your house. Data: U.S. EIA (2024 average residential bill; 2025 price breakdown, AEO 2026). Which part surprised you? #electricity #electricbill #utilities #personalfinance #dollartrail

2 a.m., and your brain has stacked every future problem into one pile. Marcus Aurelius told himself not to think about his whole life at once. Ask what in this one moment is actually past bearing, then shrink it to the next hour. Source: Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 8.36, tr. George Long. #stoicism #marcusaurelius #overwhelm #anxiety #meditations #stoic

Prices rose 3.4% in the year to August 2026. Gasoline rose 27.4%. Fuel oil rose 52.0%. Take out food and energy and it was 2.4%. That gap is why the headline number can feel wrong at the pump. Data: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index, August 2026 (12-month changes, not seasonally adjusted). Which price have you noticed most? #inflation #cpi #gasprices #economy #personalfinance #dollartrail

That email ruined your morning? Marcus Aurelius noticed that "I have been harmed" is usually a line we add ourselves. Drop that line and the harm goes with it. Source: Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 4.7, tr. George Long. #stoicism #marcusaurelius #mindset #resilience #stoic

There's no set price for one Spotify stream. Spotify paid the music industry more than $11 billion in 2025, and each artist's cut depends on their share of all streams. Data: Spotify, Loud & Clear (2025 royalty data). How many streams does your favorite small artist get? #spotify #musicindustry #streaming #artists #dollartrail

Wide awake the night before a big presentation? Epictetus said a singer is calm when he sings alone and nervous on stage, because on stage he wants applause, and the applause isn't up to him. Practice the part that is. Then go to sleep. Source: Epictetus, Discourses 2.13, tr. George Long. #stoicism #epictetus #anxiety #publicspeaking #stoic

Your 6.2% Social Security tax isn't saved in an account with your name on it. It pays people now. In 2025 Social Security paid $1,597 billion in benefits to 70 million people, and it spent more than it took in. Data: Social Security Administration, Office of the Chief Actuary; 2026 OASDI Trustees Report. #socialsecurity #taxes #paycheck #retirement #personalfinance #dollartrail

Someone took credit for your work and you've spent the evening replaying it. Marcus Aurelius didn't tell himself to hold the anger in. He wrote that the anger and vexation often hurt us more than the act itself. So question it before you reply. Source: Marcus Aurelius, Meditations 11.18, tr. George Long. #stoicism #marcusaurelius #anger #mindset #emotions #stoic

Out of every $1 you pay for health insurance, at least 80 cents has to go to medical care and quality improvement (85 cents in the large group market). Insurers that missed it owed $1.64 billion in rebates for 2024. Data: CMS, Medical Loss Ratio rules and 2024 MLR Rebates by State. Ever gotten a rebate check from your insurer? #healthinsurance #affordablecareact #personalfinance #healthcare #dollartrail
